recipe.title: Carrot Cake
recipe.ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 cups sugar
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
3 cups finely shredded carrot
1 cup cooking oil
4 eggs

actions.text: Pour into 2 greased and floured 9 x 1½-inch round baking pans
actions.groupName: Pour into greased and floured baking pans

actions.text: Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes or till a toothpick inserted near the centers comes out clean
actions.groupName: Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or till a toothpick inserted near the centers comes out clean
